Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Welcome to "Lucky Enough"! Newly renovated bathrooms in 2022!



Each reservation of this property also includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, backpack beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



As soon as you pull up to this charming cottage, you are sure to feel like you couldn't be luckier in this prime Seaside location. With a private screened in porch, your very own swimming pool, and an outdoor shower to wash off the sand at the end of the day, Lucky Enough is sure to become your new favorite destination. Walking distance to shops and restaurants, and biking distance to Seaside, the location of this home cannot be beat!



Sleeping Arrangements: (Sleeps 8)



-Guest Bedroom with Queen Sized Bed and Twin Bunks-Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo

-Master Suite with King Sized Bed- Private Bathroom with Jacuzzi Tub and Walk in Shower

-Guest Bedroom with Queen Sized Bed-Shared Bathroom off the Hallway



This charming home has three bedrooms, and three bathrooms and is a ranch-style home, offering plenty of space all while feeling cozy. Upon entering the home, you will notice the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas. There is plenty of seating at the dining room table for the entire family to enjoy meal times together, and plenty of space in the kitchen to cook delicious meals. The living room is the perfect place for rest and relaxation with couches facing a flat screen T.V. For those who enjoy the outdoors, relax on the screened-in back porch and enjoy your morning cup of coffee!



The first bedroom down the hallway features a Queen sized bed and twin bunks, with a private bathroom. As you walk further down the hallway you will see the second bedroom on the left which is the master suite. The master suite has a king-sized bed and a private ensuite bathroom! This bedroom also has its own access to the screened-in porch. There is a shared bathroom in the hall, and then the third bedroom with a queen-sized bed and porch access.



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



Amenities:

- Parking for 2 vehicles MAX

-Private Pool

-Gas Grill

-Dining Room Seating for 6, Plus 4 at the Bar

-Washer and Dryer

-Screened in Porch

- Outdoor Shower

-Short Walk to the Beach Access

-Close to shops, restaurants, and the heart of Seaside



Book your next trip here, and be "Lucky Enough" to call this your new home away from home!



**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
